title: Seasonal Produce Strategy
summary: In-season produce costs less and tastes better.
origins: Local food sourcing connects cooks to seasonality, community, and often better flavor per dollar when buying peak produce.
history: USDA seasonal charts + local extension office guides for your zone.
teaching: In-season produce costs less and tastes better.
Freeze berries and corn at peak; can tomatoes in late summer.
Use SousChef meal plans weighted to what is in season near you.
